name: usage-clock-display
description: Shows the usage-clock status line (five-hour window, weekly limit, context, cache clock, cost) under the prompt in the Claude desktop app, which does not show the statusLine, writes the app's usage numbers for the usage-clock hooks, and adds /report, a pane with the usage report.

config_file.title: usage-clock config.json
config_file.description: The config.json the usage-clock hooks read; its statusline thresholds colour this line, too. Missing file: the defaults.
